comments.text: Two team-launcher tooling issues hit live during the Arc 74 (stoa--x5t) launch. (1) BRIEF-FILENAME BRITTLENESS: launch-team.ps1 -ArcId derives the brief filenames as HUMAN_paste-polybius_<slug>-<ArcId>-instruction.md + HUMAN_paste-pliny-<ArcId>-instruction.md with ArcId = the FULL ticket id, but the historical attachment convention is inconsistent (arc-61, arc67, yh2.1, stoa--xa4 all differ) -- so a brief attached under any other name silently fails to resolve and the -ArcId path cannot launch. I had to re-attach the Arc 74 briefs under the full-id names to make the script work. FIX: make the launcher resolve the brief robustly (glob attachments/<ArcId>/HUMAN_paste-polybius_*-instruction.md + pliny, or accept an explicit --fm-brief/--pl-brief, or standardize + enforce the naming at attach time). (2) RECORD-SEAT PREFIX HARDCODE: record-seat writes the seat registry to stoa--reg regardless of project -- correct at the-stoa, but a non-the-stoa consumer (stoa_of_science) gets a mis-prefixed stoa--reg ticket in its own bw. FIX: derive the registry ticket prefix from the project's bw prefix, not hardcode stoa--reg. Both NON-BLOCKING; tooling hardening. [from: user-tier Polybius_the_Stoa | sid 990b0750-5572-4836-b9c7-18d626a12e96]

title: team-launcher hardening: brittle brief-filename convention + record-seat stoa--reg hardcode
